claim: A KDP paperback spine is page count x paper thickness, with nothing added: a 100-page 6 x 9 book on cream paper has a 0.25 inch spine and a 12.5 x 9.25 inch full cover. Calculators that add 0.06 inch are using a hardcover allowance. The free Puzzle Press spine calculator also leaves the spine blank under 80 pages, because KDP's help gives 79 in one place and 80 for Cover Creator.
notes: Real-time capture of the live spine calculator at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels, 6x9 on cream. It shows 100 pages (0.250 inch spine, 12.500 x 9.250 inch cover, and the sum line), then types 79 (spine text: not allowed) and 80 (allowed, but a 0.075 inch safe area, so left blank), then holds on the page's warning about the 0.06 inch. KDP help G201953020, re-read 2026-10-18: cream is page count x 0.0025 inch, white x 0.002252 inch, nothing added to the spine. The final 2.2 s hold still for the end card.
